How to Access NotebookLM Via API?

result.notes: Consumer NotebookLM (notebooklm.google.com) has no public/self-serve API — community requests for one remain unfulfilled and existing "NotebookLM MCP" servers are unofficial browser-automation wrappers around the consumer web UI, not a documented API. The only documented, vendor-published API is for NotebookLM/Gemini Notebook Enterprise (part of Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise/Agentspace line), which must be purchased/licensed as a Google Cloud product (standalone or via Gemini Enterprise) before OAuth2 bearer-token API calls work; several endpoints (e.g. audio-overview generation) are marked Pre-GA Preview. No free/self-serve tier exists for the API itself.
result.one_liner: NotebookLM is Google's AI research/notebook tool that grounds answers in user-uploaded sources; a documented REST API exists only for the paid Enterprise edition, not the free consumer product.
